name: midir
description: Companion app for retail Dark Ages — a searchable item index and character record across all of your characters
author: Caeldeth

scripts.validate: npm run lint:check && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test

//overrides: ONE override, global-agent@3 -> ^4.1.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, 8 moderate findings in one chain). The advisory is on sprintf-js and covers every version, so no sprintf-js release fixes it. The path is electron-builder -> app-builder-lib -> @electron/get@3 -> global-agent@3 -> roarr -> sprintf-js, and electron-builder 26.17 and the 27 alpha still pin @electron/get@3. global-agent 4 has no roarr and keeps the bootstrap export that @electron/get calls. Build-time only: nothing here ships. The selector stops matching when @electron/get moves off 3.x; remove it then. BEFORE YOU ADD ANOTHER: check whether every consumer's existing range already permits a patched version. Often npm update <pkg> is the whole fix, and it was here for source-map-js and http-cache-semantics. If you do need an override, SCOPE IT TO THE MAJOR ("pkg@1": "^1.1.18"), because an advisory is usually patched within every major. A bare "pkg": "^5" drags every consumer across majors and breaks any that depends on the old export shape. A green typecheck/lint/test/package proves nothing against that class of bug. The house template carries the same override and this note.
//devDependencies: @electron/fuses is here for ONE reason: scripts/verify-fuses.test.mjs pins the copied SENTINEL and state bytes against it, and a pin on a transitive dependency is a pin on whatever the tree happens to hoist. app-builder-lib depends on it too and is what actually flips the wire at package time. Nothing imports it at run time -- the verifier reads the artifact with fs.
//allowScripts: npm 12 runs a dependency's install script only when this block approves it, and it skips the rest SILENTLY: a warning at the end of npm install or npm ci, exit 0 (HTOO-542). esbuild's postinstall selects its platform binary. electron-winstaller is denied: its script only selects a 7-Zip binary for Squirrel.Windows installers, and electron-builder.yml ships NSIS and portable only. fsevents is the macOS file watcher behind vite, rollup and Playwright; it is optional and installs on macOS only, so it is approved for a checkout that runs the unit tests on a Mac, although Midir builds for Windows only. electron is absent: since Electron 42 it has no install script. The project's OWN postinstall runs install-electron instead (a no-op when the binary is there), because electron-vite dev reads the binary's path without require(), so a fresh clone could not run npm run dev ('Electron uninstall') without it (HTOO-553). The workspace addon packages/da-pcap is not gated by this block: npm 12 runs a workspace member's own gyp build. The postinstall's install-app-deps then rebuilds it for Electron's ABI. Approvals are by name, never pkg@version: a pinned approval stops matching at the next bump. npm install-scripts ls reports anything new.
